CustomField.description: Why the chain left the happy path. Set by the framework at each terminal or stall transition. Empty on healthy chains and on records created before this field existed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Step Exception = a step failed or crashed. Retries Exhausted = a step kept failing after its configured retries. Kill Switch = the AsyncChain feature flag stopped it. Stalled = recovery acted on a chain that lost its background job. Operator Abort = an operator stopped the chain from the Chain Monitor. Empty when the chain completed normally. Managed automatically; shown for diagnostics.
CustomField.label: Failure Category
